system.description:
Weakpoints: Make a Power Roll (14) to scan a target and find its weakpoints. On a success you can ask the GM a question about the target. On a failure the target notices your attempt.

Backstab: Make a Power Roll against the target. On a success you can use a weak point and the next attack against that target deals an additional 2d20 damage.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
